variants.V1: NOISE only if prior VIX >= pick median
variants.V2: NOISE only if prior VIX < pick median
variants.G5: CANDACE only if prior VIX >= pick median
variants.G6: CANDACE only if prior VIX < pick median

pick_rule: per strategy: pick trades >= 60, pick PF > base, pick net >= base; highest pick PF (else REJECT)
control: judge net above the 95th pct of 5000 random subsets of the judge trades of the same size
